previousFullSpec.basis: Unmodified public versioned export (-version 2026-09-07) at Flint main 0f83faf0, byte-identical to the committed developers export. Includes canonical path naming (flint#2453), required union tags (FLI-420), optional non-US address state and postal_code, buyer store credit return previews and closed request schemas (flint#2505).

profileCorrections.authentication: Exact complete security alternatives for five modes; checkoutToken uses CheckoutSessionBearer. The apiKey shortcut sends merchant/BearerAuth. The merchantKey mode is removed because the export no longer declares ApiKeyHeader (X-API-Key).
profileCorrections.requestStyle: Preserve positional IDs and flat params except 13 operations with non-object union bodies, which require object-style {path IDs, body} inputs. The exact overrides are recorded in the common profile.
profileCorrections.releasePolicy: semver, version 7.0.0; retries and idempotency keys derived from each operation's idempotency class (scripts/profiles.mjs).
profileCorrections.methodCompatibility: Keep previous same-ID and same-route-rename public resource/method bindings. Eight cross-resource moved methods remain primary bindings under their published 3.0.0 names; no paymentReviews, giftCards.adjustBalance/cashOut, or merchantBillingInvoices replacements are added. invoices.reverseManualPayment is already canonical. Only Location publishGeography/updateInventory are deprecated aliases of locations.update. Action-dependent inventory names are removed; expose only inventoryCounts.transition and inventoryReservations.transition. In 7.0.0 the developer sandbox, auth context, request log, resource timeline and partner app methods keep their names on the canonical paths (cross-resource moves). Same-resource renames keep the 5.x names as deprecated aliases: me.listFlintWalletPaymentMethods, me.listPayments, me.getPayment, invoices.getOrCreateCheckoutSession, returnResolutions.getOrCreateCheckoutSession and checkoutSessions.getDeliverySelectionHistory.
profileCorrections.paymentIntents: Create/get payloads expose payment fields directly; current source nullability applies without overrides.
profileCorrections.webhooks: Resources use data.object and exact int64 strings, including amounts beyond the safe native integer range.
profileCorrections.risk: Plural values is required; obsolete singular-value and nullability overrides are absent.
profileCorrections.models: Port the current fixture model-name collision resolutions without source constraint overrides.
profileCorrections.examples: Port current synthetic fixture request examples and strict shared HTTP/model cases; test provider errors through real clients.
profileCorrections.httpFixtures: Current generator fixtures, with explicit synthetic keys for required-key operations because production keeps automatic keys disabled.
profileCorrections.generatorAliasLimitation: Generator 314de2ee supports deprecated method aliases only within one resource, and cannot bind or constrain fixed request-body values. Cross-resource deprecated aliases are unsupported; production primary bindings preserve the eight existing names instead. The five action-dependent inventory aliases are intentionally omitted.
profileCorrections.overrides: Exact-equivalent JSON Pointer overrides in the common profile: int64 format instead of unsafe 2^63-1 bounds, a lookahead-free pattern for the flint_ metadata key reservation, not/required instead of false property schemas on PartnerAppCredential, and single-key alternatives for the recursive DeliveryEligibilityExpression and DeliveryZoneConfiguration unions. See spec/README.md.

fullSpec.basis: Unmodified public versioned export (-version 2026-09-07) from a detached clean Flint origin/main worktree. Prior release and fixture evidence is preserved in previousFullSpec and the top-level historical records.

profileCorrections.requestStyle: All methods take positional path IDs, flat params, then request options. Idempotency-Key is accepted only through request options.
profileCorrections.methodCompatibility: Path-derived namespaces and methods; all deprecated aliases removed. currentMethodBindings records renamed and added operations; unchanged operations follow the same path rule.
profileCorrections.integers: Native number counters with safe-integer validation; integers inside Money remain exact strings.
profileCorrections.queryArrays: Scalar or array inputs for array query parameters.
profileCorrections.errors: API error objectPath error; first-class public fields; status-based classes; IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_PROGRESS is an in-progress code.
profileCorrections.releasePolicy: semver, prerelease 8.0.0-beta.1 from Flint main on npm next; stable releases pin the production backend commit.
profileCorrections.overrides: Exact-equivalent corrections for metadata key predicates, excluded partner credential fields, recursive single-key unions and unsafe int64 bound literals. See spec/README.md.
profileCorrections.responseTypes: Responses declared with $ref reuse the named API component in Node and PHP, without per-operation wrapper types. Inline response schemas use operation names without status suffixes.
